name: paste-peek
description: Windows only: a small floating strip over Windows Terminal that previews each [Image #N] you paste or drop, until you send

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Colors of the strip; match your terminal background

bottom_offset.title: Distance from window bottom
bottom_offset.description: Pixels at 100% scaling between the strip and the bottom of the terminal window; raise it if the strip covers your prompt or status lines

right_offset.title: Distance from window right edge
right_offset.description: Pixels at 100% scaling between the strip and the right edge of the terminal window
